page2.text:
"What did I just..."
What was I doing?
For a second, I tried undoing the cloth wrap.
I don't understand what happened after that.
What happened to me?
What will happen to me?
It took place just a few seconds ago, but I can't remember it at all...

page3.text:
"...I can't do it. Seriously."
If I take it off, I'll die.
The priest was telling the truth.
I don't know exactly what's happening, but whatever's under that cloth, it isn't mine.

page4.text:
"...Just forget it. I can't move my arm, that's all. If I keep thinking about it..."
My mind will go dull from the terror.
I can't afford to let that happen.
Archer didn't give up his arm to save my life just so I could freeze in fear.

page5.text:
"...Yeah. I should think about Sakura, not my arm."
Sakura seemed the same as she was this morning, but I never know when she might collapse.
...I need to defeat Zouken and obtain the Holy Grail before then.
Right now, I need to think of ways to make that happen.
Ways to beat Zouken and Assassin with one arm.
...And they're not my only enemies.
We're facing a mysterious, unknown foe too.

page6.text:
...
I don't know the story behind it.
I have no idea what that black Shadow is, nor how Saber became Zouken's Servant.
All I know is that she's my enemy now.
